_comment: Truth Lenz AI - detector configuration. All weights and thresholds are documented below and editable without code changes. Scores are 0-100; 50 = neutral.

bands._comment: Human-readable probability bands shown in the UI. These describe likelihood, NOT certainty.

confidence._comment: Confidence (how much to trust the probability) is modelled separately from probability. It starts from mean analyzer confidence and is reduced by the penalties below.
confidence._disagreement_note: If the confidence-weighted std-dev of analyzer AI scores exceeds this, signals are deemed to disagree.

quality._comment: Image-quality gates. Below min_analysis_resolution the evidence is too thin and the verdict becomes INCONCLUSIVE with 'insufficient evidence'.

verdict_thresholds._comment: Applied to the ensemble AI/manipulation probabilities (0-100). The margin requirements prevent flip-flopping when signals are close, and disagreement forces INCONCLUSIVE.
verdict_thresholds._margin_note: To win, the leading hypothesis must exceed the runner-up by at least this margin; otherwise INCONCLUSIVE.

weights._comment: Per-analyzer weight in the ensemble for the AI-generation probability and the manipulation probability. Higher weight = more influence. Rationale: signals with stronger empirical grounding (metadata signatures, frequency anomalies, noise characteristics) carry more weight than purely descriptive statistics.

ai_artifacts.note: Heuristic synthetic-texture indicators; kept honest about being heuristic.

compression.note: Recompression and block inconsistencies are classic manipulation indicators.

external_model.note: A trained detector is ONE strong signal when present; never the whole verdict.

frequency.note: Generative upsampling leaves spectral fingerprints; weaker for manual edits.

manipulation.note: Copy-move / splicing indicators target manipulation specifically.

metadata.note: Explicit generator/editing-software tags are the most direct evidence available locally.

noise.note: Camera sensors leave consistent noise; synthetic images often deviate.

pixel.note: ELA and texture anomalies feed both hypotheses.

statistics.note: Descriptive; weak on its own, mainly supports quality assessment and charts.

quality.note: Quality gates reliability; weak vote, mainly drives confidence penalties.

ensemble_v2._comment: Hybrid ensemble: forensic signals + ML detector signals + provenance. ML must NOT automatically dominate forensics (allow_ml_dominance=false caps ML weight at the forensics weight). Significant ML/forensics disagreement increases uncertainty and can force INCONCLUSIVE.
